items.title: Carrier (CARR) Appoints Neil Barua To Board As Tech Focus Comes Into View
items.summary: Carrier Global (NYSE:CARR) has appointed technology executive Neil Barua as an independent director. Barua will serve on the Compensation Committee and the Technology & Innovation Committee. The appointment adds experience from his leadership roles at PTC Inc. and ServiceMax to Carrier Global's board. items.title: PTC (NASDAQ:PTC) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q2 CY2026 Earnings
items.summary: Product design software company PTC (NASDAQ:PTC) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales falling 6.8% year on year to $600 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s outlook exceeded expectations with revenue guided to $660 million at the midpoint, or 1.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.58 per share was 1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
